videos.title: My Christmas Hero
videos.description: An army reserve doctor tracks down her family's military history with the help of a new romance.

videos.title: A Royal Icing Christmas
videos.description: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.

videos.title: A Christmas Prayer
videos.description: Struggling with creative burnout, a children's book illustrator finds unexpected inspiration when she learns about a girl's Christmas wish for her recently widowed father to find happiness again.

videos.title: 'Twas the Text Before Christmas
videos.description: A text message mistakenly sent to Addie leads to a friendship with the sender, a Christmas tradition with the woman's family, and a budding romance with her son.

videos.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
videos.description: Stranded in an arctic town during Christmastime, a single father and his 20-year-old daughter meet a wildlife conservationist who helps them navigate the frozen wilderness.

videos.title: Christmas Keepsake
videos.description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

videos.title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
videos.description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

videos.title: The Trouble With Christmas Mistletoe
videos.description: An executive returns home for Christmas and reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

videos.title: Jingle Bell Princess
videos.description: After a series of mishaps, sophisticated Princess Amelia becomes stranded in the small town of Tucker Maine, where she becomes a guest of the unsuspecting Cutler family, widowed father Sam and daughter Sophie, but doesn't tell them she's a princess.

videos.title: The Christmas Yes List
videos.description: A chronic people-pleaser returns home for Christmas, determined to finally say yes to herself. An unexpected romance helps her discover that life's greatest gifts often come when you stop fearing the answer.

videos.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
videos.description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.

videos.title: Fir Crazy
videos.description: A reluctant Christmas-tree seller (Sarah Lancaster) finds renewed holiday spirit and new romance with a repeat customer (Eric Johnson), but a mean-spirited executive (Colin Mochrie) threatens to shut down her family's business.

videos.title: A Little Women's Christmas
videos.description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

videos.title: A Vintage Christmas
videos.description: A dedicated preservationist battles a developer's ambitions to tear down a historic Post Office with ties to her family. The choice of old versus new threatens to divide the small town unless there is a solution for the greater good of all concerned.

videos.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
videos.description: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker.".

videos.title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
videos.description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

videos.title: Angel Falls Christmas
videos.description: A devoted doctor with little time for the Christmas spirit is in desperate need of an intervention from the unlikeliest of places.

videos.title: A Cinderella Christmas Ball
videos.description: A dance instructor finds an old photo of a couple who may be her mother and father. Hoping to solve the mystery of her birth family, she travels to Havenshire where she meets a charming prince who dances with her at the Christmas ball.

videos.title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
videos.description: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy. Ally always saw Joy's sacrifices for the shop as a burden on Joy's life and happiness. When Ally returns to the shop to prepare it for sale, she meets Bennett, an old soul, who wants to preserve her Grandma Joy's legacy.

videos.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
videos.description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

videos.title: Bringing Christmas Home
videos.description: A professor of military history teams with an antique store owner to help track down the original owner of a historic World War II uniform and the love letters in its pockets.

videos.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
videos.description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.

videos.title: Letters This Christmas
videos.description: When a once-beloved Christmas novelist returns home to Starlight Point to save her career, she's pulled back into the traditions she shared with her late father - including writing the town pageant.

videos.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
videos.description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

videos.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
videos.description: A designer visits her Ozark hometown for Christmas, reconnecting with family craft traditions and faith. Through Paul's support, she discovers meaning in work centered on community and heritage.

videos.title: A Christmas for the Ages
videos.description: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.

videos.title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
videos.description: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

videos.title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
videos.description: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy. Ally always saw Joy's sacrifices for the shop as a burden on Joy's life and happiness. When Ally returns to the shop to prepare it for sale, she meets Bennett, an old soul, who wants to preserve her Grandma Joy's legacy.

videos.title: Hot Chocolate Holiday
videos.description: A coffee shop owner finds herself in competition with the handsome owner of a dessert shop whose hot chocolate tastes just like her grandmother's secret recipe.

videos.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
videos.description: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

videos.title: A Second Chance Christmas
videos.description: Divorced for five years, Anna and James reluctantly agree to meet their daughter's boyfriend at a rustic cabin. But when an ice storm traps them in the mountains, they're forced to confront the history they share as old feelings resurface.

videos.title: Christmas Under the Northern Lights
videos.description: A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, which is famous for experiencing the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who shows her the town's Christmas traditions.

videos.title: Journey to Christmas
videos.description: A winter storm forces a New York City fashion model to spend the week before Christmas with her chauffeur and his extended family in rural America.

videos.title: Letters This Christmas
videos.description: When a once-beloved Christmas novelist returns home to Starlight Point to save her career, she's pulled back into the traditions she shared with her late father - including writing the town pageant.

videos.title: Home Sweet Christmas
videos.description: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.
